blocks.zh: 第五至七部分及附件A：法規行政策略、參考文獻與查廠問題清單
blocks.en: Parts V to VII and Attachment A: Regulatory/Administrative Strategy, References and Inspection Questions

blocks.zh: 📋 本節學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: 📋 Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 熟記 FDA 對無菌製程查廠的 16 類缺失類型，了解每類缺失的法規行政行動意義
blocks.en: Memorize the 16 categories of deficiencies FDA identifies in sterile drug process inspections, and understand what each means for regulatory and administrative action

blocks.zh: 掌握 Part VI 的主要參考文獻（21 CFR、FDA 指引、PDA TR、ISO 標準）
blocks.en: Master the key references in Part VI (21 CFR, FDA guidance, PDA TRs, ISO standards)

blocks.zh: 了解 Part VII 中 CDER 的角色：OPQ/OS 監督、Warning Letter 行政建議、藥品短缺平衡考量
blocks.en: Understand CDER's role in Part VII: OPQ/OS oversight, Warning Letter administrative recommendations, and drug shortage considerations

blocks.zh: 認識 Attachment A 的 8 大主題，作為實地查廠問題清單的框架
blocks.en: Know the 8 topics of Attachment A as a framework for on-site inspection questions

blocks.zh: 理解 FDA 法規行動的優先考量：Warning Letter 只是起點，嚴重問題可直接進入更強力法規行動
blocks.en: Understand FDA's priorities in regulatory action: a Warning Letter is only a starting point, and serious problems can go directly to stronger regulatory action

blocks.zh: Part V: Regulatory/Administrative Strategy ── 法規行政策略
blocks.en: Part V: Regulatory/Administrative Strategy

blocks.zh: ⚖️ 法規行政策略的查廠觀點
blocks.en: ⚖️ The Inspection Perspective on Regulatory/Administrative Strategy

blocks.zh: 🚨 16 類重大缺失的分類邏輯
blocks.en: 🚨 Classification Logic of the 16 Significant Deficiencies

blocks.zh: FDA 列出這 16 類缺失，是幫助查廠員判斷「哪些問題嚴重到需要啟動法規行政行動」。可以分成幾大群組理解：
blocks.en: FDA lists these 16 deficiencies to help investigators judge "which problems are serious enough to trigger regulatory or administrative action." They can be understood in several groups:

blocks.zh:
缺失 1–3：產品直接品質問題
污染、規格失敗、分銷不合格品 ── 消費者已或可能已接觸到問題產品
blocks.en:
Deficiencies 1-3: Direct product quality problems
Contamination, specification failures, distribution of nonconforming product. Consumers have been, or may have been, exposed to the affected product.

blocks.zh:
缺失 4–5：關鍵驗證失敗
末端滅菌驗證、Media Fill 驗證 ── 製程的「無菌保證基礎」無法建立
blocks.en:
Deficiencies 4-5: Critical validation failures
Terminal sterilization validation and media fill validation. The "basis for sterility assurance" of the process cannot be established.

blocks.zh:
缺失 6：調查系統崩壞
OOS / 陽性測試結果無有效調查或 CAPA ── 問題沒被發現或被掩蓋
blocks.en:
Deficiency 6: Breakdown of the investigation system
No effective investigation or CAPA for OOS / positive test results. Problems go undetected or are concealed.

blocks.zh:
缺失 7–9：基礎設施問題
廠房設備不足、消毒程序失效、WFI 系統問題 ── 製造環境本身有問題
blocks.en:
Deficiencies 7-9: Infrastructure problems
Inadequate facilities and equipment, ineffective sanitization procedures, WFI system problems. The manufacturing environment itself is flawed.

blocks.zh:
缺失 10–11：人員問題
無菌操作不良、訓練不足 ── 人為因素是無菌失敗的主要來源
blocks.en:
Deficiencies 10-11: Personnel problems
Poor aseptic technique and inadequate training. Human factors are the main source of sterility failures.

blocks.zh:
缺失 12–13：操作與記錄問題
目視檢驗不足、批次記錄不完整 ── 無法保證每批品質
blocks.en:
Deficiencies 12-13: Operations and records problems
Inadequate visual inspection and incomplete batch records. Quality of each batch cannot be assured.

blocks.zh:
缺失 14–16：監測與測試系統問題
測試方法不適當、EM 程序不足、人員監測不足 ── 偵測系統失靈
blocks.en:
Deficiencies 14-16: Monitoring and testing system problems
Inappropriate test methods, inadequate EM procedures, inadequate personnel monitoring. The detection system has failed.

blocks.zh: 💡 Warning Letter 的行政本質
blocks.en: 💡 The Administrative Nature of a Warning Letter

blocks.zh: CPGM 7356.002A 明確指出：Warning Letter 是一種行政建議行動（advisory action），而非最終懲處。它傳遞的訊息是：「FDA 已識別問題，請改正，否則將採取更強力措施。」
blocks.en: CPGM 7356.002A states clearly that a Warning Letter is an advisory action, not a final penalty. The message it conveys is: "FDA has identified problems; correct them, or stronger measures will follow."

blocks.zh: 對於嚴重的違規（如已有汙染產品流出市場），FDA 可以跳過 Warning Letter 直接採取法律行動（Recall、Seizure、Injunction）。
blocks.en: For serious violations (for example, contaminated product already released to the market), FDA can skip the Warning Letter and take legal action directly (recall, seizure, injunction).

blocks.zh: Part VI: References & Contacts ── 參考文獻與聯絡資訊
blocks.en: Part VI: References & Contacts

blocks.zh: 📚 參考文獻架構解析
blocks.en: 📚 Structure of the References

blocks.zh: 📋 PDA 技術報告快速記憶
blocks.en: 📋 Quick Memory Aid for PDA Technical Reports

blocks.zh: TR1：濕熱滅菌驗證（Moist Heat Sterilization）
blocks.en: TR1: Validation of moist heat sterilization

blocks.zh: TR22：無菌灌裝製程模擬（Media Fill for Aseptic）
blocks.en: TR22: Process simulation for aseptic filling (media fill)

blocks.zh: TR26：液體除菌過濾（Sterilizing Filtration）
blocks.en: TR26: Sterilizing filtration of liquids

blocks.zh: TR28：無菌原料藥製程模擬（Sterile Bulk API Media Fill）
blocks.en: TR28: Process simulation for sterile bulk API (media fill)

blocks.zh: TR51：氣相/蒸汽相去汙生物指示劑（Isolator / VPHP BI）
blocks.en: TR51: Biological indicators for gaseous/vapor phase decontamination (isolator / VHP BI)

blocks.zh: 🌐 ISO 標準對應
blocks.en: 🌐 Corresponding ISO Standards

blocks.zh: ISO 17665：濕熱滅菌（蒸汽）→ 醫療器材滅菌標準，也適用藥品
blocks.en: ISO 17665: Moist heat sterilization (steam) → a medical device sterilization standard that also applies to drugs

blocks.zh: ISO 14644：潔淨室分類與監測 → 無菌製程環境管制的技術基礎
blocks.en: ISO 14644: Cleanroom classification and monitoring → the technical basis for environmental control in aseptic processing

blocks.zh: ISO 14698：生物汙染管制 → EM 程序設計的參考框架
blocks.en: ISO 14698: Biocontamination control → a reference framework for designing EM programs

blocks.zh: 📧 藥品短缺聯絡機制
blocks.en: 📧 Drug Shortage Contact Mechanism

blocks.zh: CDER 要求廠商主動回報可能影響藥品供應的情況（包含 FDA 查廠行動可能導致停產）。
blocks.en: CDER asks manufacturers to proactively report situations that may affect drug supply (including production stoppages that FDA inspection actions may cause).

blocks.zh: 聯絡信箱：DrugShortages@CDER.fda.gov
blocks.en: Contact email: DrugShortages@CDER.fda.gov

blocks.zh: 這反映了 FDA 的雙重目標：確保品質合規 同時 維持藥品可及性（drug availability），兩者需要平衡。
blocks.en: This reflects FDA's dual goals: ensuring quality compliance while maintaining drug availability. The two must be balanced.

blocks.zh: 💡 為什麼 FDA Guidance 等同法規？
blocks.en: 💡 Why Is FDA Guidance Treated Like a Regulation?

blocks.zh: FDA Guidance Document 雖然法律上是「建議」，但在實務中被視為標準。原因是：若廠商不依循 FDA Guidance，FDA 在查廠時會要求廠商解釋「為什麼採用不同做法」以及「如何證明替代方案同等有效」。這個舉證責任極重，等同於強制遵守。
blocks.en: An FDA guidance document is legally only a "recommendation," but in practice it is treated as the standard. The reason: if a manufacturer does not follow FDA guidance, FDA will ask during inspection "why a different approach was used" and "how the alternative is shown to be equivalent." This burden of proof is so heavy that it amounts to mandatory compliance.

blocks.zh: Part VII: Center Responsibilities ── 中心職責
blocks.en: Part VII: Center Responsibilities

blocks.zh: 🏛️ CDER 中心職責的管理架構
blocks.en: 🏛️ Management Structure of CDER Center Responsibilities

blocks.zh: ⚠️ Warning Letter 的本質：行政建議，非最終懲處
blocks.en: ⚠️ The Nature of a Warning Letter: Advisory, Not a Final Penalty

blocks.zh: 很多人誤解 Warning Letter 是 FDA 最嚴厲的行動，實際上它只是行政建議的起點：
blocks.en: Many people mistakenly think a Warning Letter is FDA's harshest action. In fact it is only the starting point of advisory action:

blocks.zh: Warning Letter = FDA 通知廠商「我們發現重大問題，請在 15 個工作日內回應」
blocks.en: Warning Letter = FDA notifies the firm "we found significant problems; respond within 15 working days"

blocks.zh: 公開於 FDA 網站，具相當大的市場/聲譽壓力
blocks.en: Posted publicly on the FDA website, creating considerable market and reputational pressure

blocks.zh: 若問題嚴重（如已有汙染品上市），可直接進行查扣（Seizure）、禁制令（Injunction）或召回（Recall）
blocks.en: If the problem is serious (for example, contaminated product already on the market), FDA can go directly to seizure, injunction or recall

blocks.zh: ⚖️ 品質合規 vs. 藥品可及性的平衡
blocks.en: ⚖️ Balancing Quality Compliance and Drug Availability

blocks.zh: CPGM 罕見地承認 FDA 在執法上面臨「雙重目標」：
blocks.en: The CPGM rarely acknowledges that FDA faces "dual goals" in enforcement:

blocks.zh: 確保 CGMP 合規：維護公眾用藥安全
blocks.en: Ensure CGMP compliance: protect public safety in drug use

blocks.zh: 維持藥品供應：避免因強制行動造成藥品短缺，尤其是無替代品的必要用藥
blocks.en: Maintain drug supply: avoid drug shortages caused by enforcement action, especially for essential drugs with no alternatives

blocks.zh: 這不意味著違規會被放過，而是 CDER 會協調行動的範圍與時機，讓廠商有機會在持續供應下進行改正。
blocks.en: This does not mean violations will be overlooked. Rather, CDER will coordinate the scope and timing of actions so that firms have the opportunity to make corrections while continuing to supply.

blocks.zh: 💡 ORA vs. CDER 的分工
blocks.en: 💡 Division of Roles: ORA vs. CDER

blocks.zh: 簡單類比：ORA 是警察（執行查廠、收集證據）；CDER 是檢察官+法官（評估證據、決定行動）。兩者密切合作，但職責分工明確。最終法規行動的決定通常需要 CDER（特別是 OPQ/OS）的參與。
blocks.en: A simple analogy: ORA is the police (conducts inspections and collects evidence); CDER is the prosecutor and judge (evaluates the evidence and decides on action). The two work closely together, but their responsibilities are clearly divided. The final decision on regulatory action usually requires CDER involvement (especially OPQ/OS).

blocks.zh: Attachment A: Inspection Questions by Topic ── 查廠問題清單（依主題）
blocks.en: Attachment A: Inspection Questions by Topic

blocks.zh: 📝 Attachment A 八大主題的查廠要點
blocks.en: 📝 Key Inspection Points for the Eight Topics in Attachment A

blocks.zh: 🔥 主題1：濕熱滅菌（Moist Heat Sterilization）
blocks.en: 🔥 Topic 1: Moist Heat Sterilization

blocks.zh: F₀ 計算方法與目標值是否有驗證基礎
blocks.en: Is there a validated basis for the F₀ calculation method and target value?

blocks.zh: BI 放置位置是否代表最冷點（cold spot）
blocks.en: Does the BI placement represent the cold spot?

blocks.zh: 最大與最小裝載量均需驗證
blocks.en: Both maximum and minimum load sizes must be validated

blocks.zh: 蒸汽品質：過熱蒸汽、不凝性氣體的控制
blocks.en: Steam quality: control of superheated steam and non-condensable gases

blocks.zh: 🌡️ 主題2：乾熱滅菌/去熱原（Dry Heat / Depyrogenation）
blocks.en: 🌡️ Topic 2: Dry Heat Sterilization / Depyrogenation

blocks.zh: 關鍵驗證指標：≥3-log 內毒素減少（通常 250°C / ≥30 分鐘）
blocks.en: Key validation criterion: ≥3-log endotoxin reduction (typically 250°C / ≥30 minutes)

blocks.zh: 溫度映射：所有位置均需達標
blocks.en: Temperature mapping: all locations must meet the criteria

blocks.zh: 隧道型去熱原爐：傳送帶速度需驗證
blocks.en: Tunnel-type depyrogenation ovens: conveyor speed must be validated

blocks.zh: 💉 主題3：無菌灌裝（Aseptic Filling）
blocks.en: 💉 Topic 3: Aseptic Filling

blocks.zh: HVAC 確認（氣流型態、煙霧測試、壓差）
blocks.en: HVAC qualification (airflow patterns, smoke studies, differential pressure)

blocks.zh: Media Fill：頻率（每半年/每班次）、設計、陽性單位處理
blocks.en: Media fill: frequency (every six months / each shift), design, handling of positive units

blocks.zh: 人員無菌技術：干預操作最關鍵
blocks.en: Personnel aseptic technique: interventions are the most critical

blocks.zh: ❄️ 主題4：凍乾（Lyophilization）
blocks.en: ❄️ Topic 4: Lyophilization

blocks.zh: 凍乾機 SIP（就地滅菌）驗證
blocks.en: Validation of lyophilizer SIP (sterilization in place)

blocks.zh: 凍乾循環開發：一次乾燥、二次乾燥、崩解溫度
blocks.en: Lyophilization cycle development: primary drying, secondary drying, collapse temperature

blocks.zh: 殘留水分測試（Karl Fischer）
blocks.en: Residual moisture testing (Karl Fischer)

blocks.zh: 塞子就位與軋蓋完整性確認
blocks.en: Confirmation of stopper seating and crimping integrity

blocks.zh: 🛡️ 主題5：隔離艙技術（Isolator）
blocks.en: 🛡️ Topic 5: Isolator Technology

blocks.zh: 去汙驗證：≥6-log BI 減少（G. stearothermophilus 或同等）
blocks.en: Decontamination validation: ≥6-log BI reduction (G. stearothermophilus or equivalent)

blocks.zh: VHP 濃度、接觸時間、通風（aeration）
blocks.en: VHP concentration, contact time, aeration

blocks.zh: 手套完整性：日常洩漏測試（routine leak test）
blocks.en: Glove integrity: routine leak testing

blocks.zh: 快速轉移口（RTP）使用管制
blocks.en: Control of rapid transfer port (RTP) use

blocks.zh: 🌫️ 主題6：非活性粒子環境監測
blocks.en: 🌫️ Topic 6: Non-Viable Particle Environmental Monitoring

blocks.zh: 粒子計數器擺放位置與確認
blocks.en: Placement and qualification of particle counters

blocks.zh: Alert/Action Level 依 ISO 等級分別定義
blocks.en: Alert/Action Levels defined separately for each ISO class

blocks.zh: 靜態（at-rest）vs 動態（in-operation）分類結果
blocks.en: Classification results at-rest vs. in-operation

blocks.zh: 🦠 主題7：活性微生物環境監測與人員監測
blocks.en: 🦠 Topic 7: Viable Microbial Environmental Monitoring and Personnel Monitoring

blocks.zh: 全班次監測（含假日班）
blocks.en: Monitoring across all shifts (including holiday shifts)

blocks.zh: 各等級各方法分別設定 Alert/Action Level
blocks.en: Alert/Action Levels set separately for each grade and each method

blocks.zh: 關鍵區域所有菌株需鑑定至菌種
blocks.en: All isolates from critical areas must be identified to species level

blocks.zh: 趨勢分析：未超標但趨勢惡化 = 需調查
blocks.en: Trend analysis: no excursion but a worsening trend = requires investigation

blocks.zh: 消毒劑輪換計劃與效力驗證
blocks.en: Disinfectant rotation program and efficacy validation

blocks.zh: 🧫 主題8：生物指示劑（Biological Indicators）
blocks.en: 🧫 Topic 8: Biological Indicators

blocks.zh: BI 規格：菌種、菌數、D 值、Z 值
blocks.en: BI specifications: organism, population, D-value, Z-value

blocks.zh: D 值驗證：到貨時及定期複驗
blocks.en: D-value verification: on receipt and periodically thereafter

blocks.zh: 陽性對照（positive control）必須包含在每次驗證運行中
blocks.en: A positive control must be included in every validation run

blocks.zh: 孵育條件：溫度、時間、判讀標準
blocks.en: Incubation conditions: temperature, time, interpretation criteria

blocks.zh: 📌 本節重點總結 Section Summary
blocks.en: 📌 Section Summary

blocks.zh: Part V — 16 類缺失：涵蓋污染、驗證失敗、調查失效、基礎設施、人員、記錄、測試與監測等各面向；不是所有缺失都需先發 Warning Letter，嚴重情況可直接採取法律行動
blocks.en: Part V - 16 deficiencies: cover contamination, validation failures, ineffective investigations, infrastructure, personnel, records, testing and monitoring; not every deficiency requires a Warning Letter first, and serious situations can go directly to legal action

blocks.zh: Warning Letter 定性：行政建議行動，非最終懲處；廠商有 15 個工作日回覆義務；Warning Letter 公開發布
blocks.en: Nature of a Warning Letter: an advisory action, not a final penalty; the firm is obliged to respond within 15 working days; Warning Letters are published

blocks.zh: Part VI — 關鍵參考文獻：21 CFR 210/211、FDA 2004 Aseptic Guidance、PDA TR 1/22/26/28/51、ISO 17665/14644/14698、ISPE RABS
blocks.en: Part VI - Key references: 21 CFR 210/211, FDA 2004 Aseptic Guidance, PDA TR 1/22/26/28/51, ISO 17665/14644/14698, ISPE RABS

blocks.zh: Part VII — CDER 職責：OPQ（技術評估）＋ OS（執法協調）；藥品短缺平衡考量；聯絡信箱 DrugShortages@CDER.fda.gov
blocks.en: Part VII - CDER responsibilities: OPQ (technical assessment) + OS (enforcement coordination); drug shortage considerations; contact email DrugShortages@CDER.fda.gov

blocks.zh: Attachment A — 8 大主題：濕熱滅菌 → 乾熱/去熱原 → 無菌灌裝 → 凍乾 → 隔離艙 → 非活性 EM → 活性 EM / 人員監測 → 生物指示劑
blocks.en: Attachment A - 8 topics: moist heat sterilization → dry heat / depyrogenation → aseptic filling → lyophilization → isolator → non-viable EM → viable EM / personnel monitoring → biological indicators

blocks.zh: 關鍵數值記憶：乾熱去熱原 ≥3-log；Isolator 去汙 ≥6-log；Media Fill ≥5,000 單位、每半年/每班；無菌取樣 48 單位；內毒素取樣 20 單位
blocks.en: Key numbers to remember: dry heat depyrogenation ≥3-log; isolator decontamination ≥6-log; media fill ≥5,000 units, every six months / each shift; sterility sampling 48 units; endotoxin sampling 20 units
